title: FairFlow: An Automated Approach to Model-based Counterfactual Data Augmentation For NLP

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring gender transfer accuracy and evaluating extrinsic bias mitigation by calculating the True Positive Rate Difference (TPRD) and False Positive Rate Difference (FPRD) between male and female groups on downstream classification tasks (Bias-in-bios, ECHR, and Jigsaw).
Qualitative analysis of counterfactual text generation robustness by substituting attribute words related to religious groups (e.g., Catholic to Muslim).
